lastRequest: Build a fullstack SaaS Expense Tracker & Budgeting web application with Express backend, Prisma SQLite database, React 18 with Vite frontend, interactive income and expense logging with category badges, monthly budget progress bars, category breakdown pie charts, downloadable CSV/PDF export, transaction filter by date range and category, edit/delete transaction modals, and dark mode glassmorphism UI theme.

tasks.title: Prisma Data Modeling and SQLite Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma with SQLite and define User, Transaction, Category, and Budget schemas with relational integrity.

tasks.title: Backend Express Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement Express server with JWT authentication middleware, Zod validation, and RESTful route controllers.

tasks.title: API Implementation and Business Logic
tasks.description: Develop transaction CRUD, analytics aggregation, and report generation endpoints protected by JWT strategy.

tasks.title: Frontend Development with React-Vite
tasks.description: Build UI components using Tailwind CSS, React-Hook-Form, and Recharts, integrating with the Express backend via Axios.

tasks.title: Integration, Validation, and Final Review
tasks.description: Verify system-wide end-to-end flows, performance, and security headers to ensure production readiness.
